about: S4b 城門口外 (part 2): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/brief_section.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; shape after sections/outer_road/talk.json). The palm-covered carts (名画记 27), the wheelwright (名画记 26), the crowd round the seated man, the tea house (余辉 小铺闲坐) and the moorings (名画记 25). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips. Plot-line steps told here: qingming.3 (V4b.1, c4b.cart2), tax.4 (V4b.2, c4b.cart1), boat.3 (V4b.5, c4b.longboat). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 大棕蓋車
scenes.reading: 名画记 27: at the crossroads two big palm-covered carts, one halted and one moving, carts for a household's women (東京夢華錄 卷三: 宅眷坐車子…棕作蓋，及前後有構欄門，垂簾); in the moving cart's rear door a woman lowers her head and lifts the curtain to look out; one ox in the shafts, one on the traces, two carters, servants with food behind, the capped rider probably the master; perhaps back from the graves. 余辉 2014 豪车云集. The map has this cart heading north-east with its lead ox turning west: we keep 名画记's 'back from the graves' and have it turning off for home (our proposal). The woman is not a mapped figure, so she is spoken to and never heard.

servant.name: 僕從
servant.src: 名画记 27 (servants follow the cart with food); the map: a man in a short jacket reaching up to the cart's rear (the family's servant is our reading)

carter.name: 車夫
carter.src: 名画记 27 (two carters tend the oxen); the map: walking beside the shaft ox

driver.name: 車夫
driver.src: 名画记 27; the map: the bare-headed driver beyond the shaft ox

master.name: 主人
master.src: 名画记 27 (the capped rider, probably the master); the map: a man in a big black hat holding the small horse behind the cart (the master is our reading)

beats.say_en: Coming through. There are ladies in the cart.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷三 (宅眷坐車子, a cart for a household's women); 名画记 27

as.fu: 娘子莫怪，車裏是我家娘子。
as.seng: 師父借過，主人家上墳回來。
as.li: 兄弟，搭把手，把這擔接下來。

as_en.guan: By your leave, sir. The household ladies ride inside.
as_en.shi: Your pardon, sir. The household ladies ride inside.
as_en.fu: Pardon, madam. My mistress is in the cart.
as_en.tong: Little one, don't go tugging at the curtain.
as_en.seng: Excuse us, Master. The family is back from the graves.
as_en.jun: Make way, soldier. Ladies in the cart.
as_en.li: Brother, lend a hand. Help me get this load down.

beats.say_en: Mistress, don't lean out. The road is crowded.
beats.src: 名画记 27 (in the rear door a woman lifts the curtain to look out); spoken to her: our proposal

beats.say_en: Back from the graves. The oxen are tired too.
beats.src: 名画记 27 (perhaps back from sweeping the graves); 東京夢華錄 清明節 (凡新墳皆用此日拜掃)

beats.say_en: Round the corner and we're nearly home.
beats.src: our proposal (the map: the cart turns at the crossroads, its lead ox heading west)

beats.say: 又來了？可是瞧這車稀罕？
beats.say_en: Back again? Curious about the cart?
beats.src: our proposal

as_en.guan: You like the palm cart too, sir?
as_en.tong: Want a ride, little one? Not a chance.

beats.say: 棕作蓋，前後有門，垂著簾。
beats.say_en: A palm-fibre roof, doors front and back, curtains hung.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷三 (但棕作蓋，及前後有構欄門，垂簾)

beats.say: 一頭駕轅，一頭拉套，走得穩。
beats.say_en: One ox in the shafts, one on the traces. A steady ride.
beats.src: 名画记 27 (一头牛驾辕，一头牛拉套)

beats.say: 籃裏是棗錮炊餅，門外土。
beats.say_en: Date cakes and buns in the basket: gifts from outside the gate.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 清明節 (各攜棗錮、炊餅…謂之門外土); 名画记 27 (servants carrying food)

beats.say: 這幾日家家出城上墳，路上擠。
beats.say_en: These days every family goes out to the graves. The roads are packed.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 清明節 (自此三日，皆出城上墳)

as_en.guan: Back from the graves too, sir?

beats.say: 掃過了墳，也算了卻一樁心事。
beats.say_en: The graves are swept. One duty off my mind.
beats.src: our proposal (名画记 27's master; 東京夢華錄 清明節)

beats.say: 娘子在看甚麼？那邊圍著好些人。
beats.say_en: What is the mistress looking at? There's a crowd over there.
beats.src: our proposal (the woman at the curtain, 名画记 27; the crowd round the seated man up the road)

scenes.title: 棕車停候
scenes.reading: 名画记 27: of the two palm-covered carts one halts and one moves (一停一走); 余辉 2014 豪车云集. The map: this one stands unhitched with no team in sight, someone seated under its front thatch, a small figure at its west end, a sedan chair set down beside it. Why it waits is not painted: we have it held up by the checks at the gate (our proposal, the tax thread, after 余辉 2023's quarrel at the gate's tax office, 名画记 35's 引子 permit and 余辉 2023's 力胜税钱 on carts and boats).

carter.name: 車夫
carter.src: the map: seated under the parked cart's front thatch, 'the carter or a servant waiting with the unhitched cart'

boy.name: 小廝
boy.src: the map: a small figure at the cart's west end, probably a child (a servant boy of the family is the map's guess)

bearer.name: 轎夫
bearer.src: the map: the young man between the poles of the sedan chair set down beside the cart, its bearer or attendant waiting

beats.say: 這車不走，客官從旁邊過。
beats.say_en: This cart isn't going anywhere. Go round it.
beats.src: the map (unhitched, no team); our proposal

as_en.guan: Pass on, sir. The cart is waiting here.
as_en.fu: Pass by, madam. Mind your skirt on the frame.
as_en.tong: Kid, don't crawl under the cart.
as_en.li: Brother, the oxen are unhitched. We're resting.
as_en.jun: Soldier, this is a family's carriage.

beats.say_en: Why aren't we going yet?
beats.src: our proposal (the small figure waiting at the cart's west end)

beats.say: 城門口查得緊，車馬都排著。
beats.say_en: The checks at the gate are strict. Carts and horses are queuing.
beats.src: our proposal (the tax thread: the gate's tax office, 余辉 2023; 名画记 35)

beats.say: 說是稅務所裏又吵起來了。
beats.say_en: They say the tax office is rowing again.
beats.src: our proposal (the tax thread: the quarrel at the tax office, 余辉 2015/2023)

beats.say_en: Back again? This cart has a while to wait yet.
beats.src: our proposal

as.guan: 官人，城門那邊可鬆了些？

as_en.guan: Sir, has it eased at the gate?

beats.say_en: Do carts pay tax too?
beats.src: our proposal

beats.say_en: Carts and boats both pay the load tax.
beats.src: 余辉 2023 (车船征收力胜税钱)

beats.say_en: Goods pay the transit tax, and silk the heaviest.
beats.src: 余辉 2023 (过税; 纺织品的课税最高)

beats.say_en: Without a permit the tax is heavier still.
beats.src: 名画记 35 (若没有这个引子，交税时税率就特别重)

beats.say_en: What's there to have fun with in the city?
beats.src: our proposal

beats.say: 瓦子裏說書弄影戲，夠你看的。
beats.say_en: Storytellers and shadow plays in the pleasure grounds. Plenty to see.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 京瓦伎藝 (小說, 影戲 in the 瓦肆)

beats.say_en: First wait for the gate to ease.
beats.src: our proposal (the tax thread)

scenes.title: 車鋪勞作
scenes.reading: 名画记 26: north of a small eating shop, a cart-repair shop with timber piled at its door, where a worker gripping a mallet trims a wheel; 余辉 2014 names it 车铺劳作, and 余辉 2021 counts the carpenter mending carts among the labourers who wear themselves out just to eat. The map: the wheel lies flat on the ground, a man in a wide dark hat watches from behind it. That the watcher owns the wheel is our proposal.

wright.name: 車匠
wright.src: 名画记 26 (a worker with a mallet trims the wheel); 余辉 2014 车铺劳作

owner.name: 車主
owner.src: the map: a man in a wide dark hat behind the wheel, watching (that it is his wheel is our proposal)

beats.say_en: Mind out, don't step on the wheel.
beats.src: the map (the wheel lying flat before the shed); our proposal

as.fu: 娘子家的棕車，也來我這修。
as.tong: 小娃兒走開，錘子不長眼。

as_en.guan: Does your cart need mending too, sir?
as_en.fu: Madam, your family's palm cart comes to me too.
as_en.tong: Off you go, kid. A mallet has no eyes.
as_en.jun: Soldier, bringing an army cart to mend?
as_en.li: Brother, lend a hand. Hold the rim down.

beats.say_en: When will it be done? I've a road to make.
beats.src: our proposal (the watcher in the wide hat)

beats.say_en: The rim's split. Replace a piece and it's done.
beats.src: 名画记 26 (修整车轮); the repair is our proposal

beats.think_en: Blow after blow, just to earn a meal.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (木工修车 among the labourers who barely earn a living)

beats.say: 門口這些木料，做轅做軸的。
beats.say_en: This timber at the door is for shafts and axles.
beats.src: 名画记 26 (门口堆积了许多木料); places.json (material for shafts and axles)

as.guan: 官人看這木料，都是上好的。

as_en.guan: Look at this timber, sir. The best there is.

beats.say: 城外車多，你這生意好做。
beats.say_en: Lots of carts outside the gate. Good trade for you.
beats.src: places.json (ox carts and palm carts come and go outside the gate)

beats.say: 大的太平車，一車載數十石。
beats.say_en: A big Taiping cart carries dozens of measures of grain.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷三 (般載車，大者曰太平…可載數十石)

beats.say_en: Big wheels take a lot of work to mend.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷三 (車兩輪與箱齊); our proposal

scenes.title: 小鋪閒坐
scenes.reading: 余辉 2014 names the vignette 小铺闲坐 (and his 城门口外真悠闲); places.json: no sign on the roof, so whether it is a teahouse is not certain. We stage a tea shop after 東京夢華錄 卷五 民俗 (neighbours stand each other tea and ask after the news, 相問動靜), its customers trading the road's news: the boat at the bridge (名画记 19) and the row at the gate (余辉 2023), our proposal. Tea at a coin a bowl: 余辉 2021.

white.name: 茶客
white.src: the map: a stout man in white on a low stool, a knee drawn up (places.json)

hat.name: 茶客
hat.src: the map: the customer in a broad dark hat across the table, listening

cap.name: 茶客
cap.src: the map: a customer in a dark cap leaning on a table in the east bay

bent.name: 茶客
bent.src: the map: a customer bending forward over a table end at the west post

beats.say_en: Sit, sit. Have a bowl of tea and rest your feet.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷五 民俗 (獻遣湯茶); 余辉 2021 (tea at a coin a bowl); our proposal

as_en.guan: Here for tea too, sir? Sit over here.
as_en.shi: Sit, sir. We're just trading news.
as_en.seng: Please sit, Master. A bowl of plain tea.
as_en.li: Sit down, brother. A coin a bowl.

beats.say: 你方才說，虹橋那邊怎地？
beats.say_en: You were saying, what happened at the Rainbow Bridge?
beats.src: our proposal (the boat's news travels, 名画记 19)

beats.say: 大船的桅桿，險些撞了橋！
beats.say_en: A big boat's mast nearly hit the bridge!
beats.src: 名画记 19; 余辉 2015 (惊悚的船桥险情)

beats.say_en: And then?
beats.src: our proposal (he leans on the table, listening)

beats.say: 滿橋的人都喊，總算放倒了。
beats.say_en: The whole bridge shouted. They got the mast down in the end.
beats.src: 名画记 19, 20 (the crowd shouting; the mast lowered)

beats.say_en: Back again? Lots of news today.
beats.src: our proposal

as_en.guan: Sit again, sir. The tea's still hot.

beats.say: 城門口稅務所，又為匹帛吵。
beats.say_en: At the gate's tax office, another row over silk.
beats.src: 余辉 2023/2021 (the quarrel over the cloth tax); the tax thread (our proposal)

beats.say_en: Silk is taxed the heaviest. No wonder they row.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (纺织品的税收在宋代是最高的)

beats.say_en: Drink your tea. Mind your own business.
beats.src: our proposal

beats.say: 鄰里每日支茶，問個動靜。
beats.say_en: Neighbours stand each other tea every day and ask the news.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷五 民俗 (每日鄰里互相支茶，相問動靜)

beats.say: 可不是，一盞茶，天下事都知了。
beats.say_en: Just so. One bowl of tea and you know all the news.
beats.src: our proposal

beats.think: 城外的茶，倒比城裏便宜。
beats.think_en: Tea outside the gate is cheaper than in town.
beats.src: our proposal

scenes.title: 河邊泊船
scenes.reading: 名画记 25: at the bend of the broad river many boats lie moored, passenger and cargo, someone boarding over a gangplank, the hulls deep in the water as if loaded to sail south. 余辉 2021 reads the moored boats as private grain boats; here we follow 名画记 25 (grain is the canal's thread). The near miss at the Rainbow Bridge is 名画记 19 and 余辉 2015, who blames the trackers for hauling right up to the bridge; that these boatmen talk of it is our proposal (the boat thread).

dark.name: 船家
dark.src: the map: a boatman in a dark cap standing on the long boat's south deck

light.name: 船家
light.src: the map: the second boatman beside him (both faint)

stern.name: 艄公
stern.src: the map: a boatman seated at the arched-awning boat's stern, the next boat in the raft

beats.say_en: Want passage? We're bound south.
beats.src: 名画记 25 (loaded deep, about to sail south)

as.jun: 軍爺要過河？這船不擺渡。
as.tong: 小娃兒莫靠船邊，掉下去了。
as.li: 兄弟，要扛活麼？貨還沒裝完。

as_en.guan: Taking passage, sir? The cabin is clean.
as_en.shi: Going home, sir? It's quiet aboard.
as_en.seng: Wandering, Master? We'll take you part of the way.
as_en.jun: Crossing, soldier? This boat is no ferry.
as_en.tong: Keep off the edge, kid. You'll fall in.
as_en.li: Brother, want work? The cargo isn't all loaded.

beats.say_en: Under the Rainbow Bridge just now: what a close call!
beats.src: our proposal (the boat thread; 名画记 19)

beats.say: 大船的桅桿，險些撞上橋。
beats.say_en: The big boat's mast nearly struck the bridge.
beats.src: 名画记 19; 余辉 2015 看点三

beats.say_en: The trackers kept hauling, heads down, and never stopped.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (the trackers should have stopped and called for the mast to come down)

beats.say_en: Lucky the people on the bridge shouted in time.
beats.src: 名画记 20; 余辉 2015 (拱桥上下的行人发现了险情，大声呼救)

beats.say: 又來了？船上沒甚麼好看。
beats.say_en: Back again? Nothing much to see on a boat.
beats.src: our proposal

beats.say_en: She sits deep. The hold is full.
beats.src: 名画记 25 (船身吃水很深…已装满了货物)

beats.say_en: When the wind is fair, we sail south.
beats.src: 名画记 25 (要启航开往南方去了)

beats.say_en: Carts and boats all pay the load tax. Sigh.
beats.src: 余辉 2023 (车船征收力胜税钱)

beats.say: 那船頂上，有人拿長篙頂住橋。
beats.say_en: On that boat's roof, a man braced a long pole against the bridge.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (船顶上的一个船夫奋力用长杆顶住拱桥横梁)

beats.say_en: An old hand. I'd have panicked.
beats.src: our proposal

beats.say: 一船兩三百客，出了事怎了。
beats.say_en: Two or three hundred passengers aboard. Think if it had gone wrong.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (北宋的一条大客船可载客两三百人)

scenes.title: 圍看稀罕
scenes.title_en: The Crowd and the Seated Man
scenes.reading: reference/scroll/sections.md S4: a crowd round a seated man under an awning, identity unchecked (Hansen pl. 17–18). The map: no signboard, table, fan or umbrella of his own, so the strokes say neither storyteller nor fortune-teller; with dark patterned goods spread before him he may be a pedlar showing wares. We stage the pedlar (his clip shows goods); what the goods are cannot be read, so no line names them.

seller.src: the map: a man seated on the ground bending over dark patterned goods spread before him (a pedlar showing wares is the map's reading)

tall.name: 閒人
tall.src: the map: the tall man in a long light robe leaning toward the seated man

bearded.name: 閒人
bearded.src: the map: the bearded man in a light robe with a sash, looking down at him

small.name: 孩童

as_en.fu: Have a look, madam. You won't find these in town.

beats.say: 又來湊熱鬧？往裏擠一擠。
